analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($74.39) vs SMA5/20/50 ($80.27/$88.38/$91.18): below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($90.61/$83.40): below mid/long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (39.5%) + current price level is relatively high compared to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.5→28.4): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.4716→-1.3798): continued worsening, maintaining a bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $76.66): approaching the lower band, confirming downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($69.44): relatively high compared to 52-week low, based on Pivot S1 ($64.77).
· Swing resistance ($75.22): first resistance zone for a short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low formed, 5-day low $72.20 vs 20-day low $72.20): potential entry into a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.00x): normal confidence level for price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Potential entry into accumulation phase): observe for oversold exit, enter long after support confirmation.
